question: Should I open a second location for my bakery, or invest in delivery first?
leaning: Open the second location. A storefront just came up for lease on Route 1.

profile.name: Rise & Shine Bakery
goals: don't put the first store at risk
profile.constraints: Revenue is about $42,000 a month. Savings cover six months of runway. I bake every morning myself and have no manager yet.
